title: Effective object permissions: the managed write clamp leaves an explicit modifyAllRecords on a guarded managed object, so current_user.can(object, 'edit') answers true where the write guard refuses
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPxYq1wQmUNWvMZkC

Filing gate: ② found by the #30370 implementer (PR #30416 Acceptance notes) and confirmed by the seat reading `origin/main` after `f7afab86`. Read from code, not reproduced through a public door. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets lane and grade. Suggested-grade: p3.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `clampManagedObjectWrites modifyAllRecords`, `managed modifyAllRecords edit` → #30370 (closed; fixed the same shape for the external write gate only), #20134 / #20136 / #14137 / #14029 (closed; super-user fold and managed-deny floor, not this). **New.**
type: Bug

## What the code does

- `clampManagedObjectWrites` (`packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`, ~L242–258) clears `allowEdit` / `allowCreate` / `allowDelete` on an object in a guarded `managedBy` bucket unless `userActions` opts in. It never touches `modifyAllRecords`.
- The spec's `objectPermissionGrants` (`packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts` ~L266–281) answers `allowEdit`, `allowDelete` and `allowTransfer` **true on `modifyAllRecords` alone**.
- So when a permission set names a guarded managed object explicitly with `modifyAllRecords: true`, the clamped entry still answers `current_user.can(object, 'edit' | 'delete' | 'transfer')` true, while the identity write guard refuses the write. The map's own docblock says it reflects what the server enforces.
- The super-user wildcard fold (`foldSuperUserWildcardGrants`) copies derived grant bits, not `modifyAllRecords`, so the wildcard-only admin is not affected; only an explicit entry is.
- PR #30416 handled the same shape for the external write gate (`clampExternalReadOnlyWrites` lowers `modifyAllRecords` to `viewAllRecords`); the managed clamp was left as it was, by scope.

## Wanted

- [ ] A guarded managed object whose write is clamped grants no edit / delete / transfer through `modifyAllRecords` either (e.g. lower it to `viewAllRecords`, as #30416 does), so `can()` and the console agree with the write guard.
- [ ] A test with an explicit `{ modifyAllRecords: true }` entry on a guarded managed object.

Reader: `domain:server` (`packages/core/src/security/**`). Links: #30370, PR #30416.
